page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.8xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a dedicated 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor featuring 16 physical cores and 32 virtual CPUs with hyper-threading enabled. Cache configuration comprises 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache, complemented by support for AVX, AVX-512, and AES instructions. The instance provides 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio suitable for memory-demanding applications.

Hardware accelerators are absent, with 0 GPUs provisioned, and the instance does not feature local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions. Baseline network throughput is configured at 6 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with the hardware profile. Benchmark testing reveals a performance profile characteristic of its CPU generation. Single-thread processing reflects lower performance tiers, recording a Geekbench single-core score of 945.0, a stress-ng single-core rating of 1108.09, and single-threaded gzip compression at 19.1 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-threaded metrics remain within average ranges, yielding a PassMark CPU score of 23224.93, a multi-core Geekbench score of 8252.0, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression at 109.28 GB/sec.

Memory bandwidth measurements demonstrate solid data transfer capabilities, showing 1309.91 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 98.84 GB/sec read and 48.76 GB/sec write for large uncached 256 MB blocks. Application tests indicate capable throughput for caching engines, achieving 22.17 million operations per second in Redis SET operations alongside 13.92 GB/sec static web serving throughput. CPU-based small LLM inference achieves 1475.73 prompt tokens per second, while text generation remains modest at 72.78 tokens per second. Balancing high memory capacity against average compute throughput, ecs.se1.8xlarge is best suited for in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, large-footprint analytical workloads, and data processing tasks requiring high RAM capacity without intense single-thread compute requirements.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.8xlarge is a memory-optimized instance running on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor at 2.5 GHz. Configured with 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores and 256.0 GB of memory, it delivers an 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU ratio. The instance includes AVX-512 instructions, a 6 Gbps network baseline, zero GPUs, and no bundled local storage. Benchmarks place its compute capability in the average tier for multi-threaded workloads, recording a PassMark CPU score of 23224.93 and a multi-core Geekbench score of 8252.0, while single-threaded tasks show lower relative output. With memory bandwidth reaching 98.84 GB/sec for uncached reads and 22.17 million Redis SET operations per second, this instance is suited for memory-intensive enterprise tasks such as distributed caching, in-memory databases, and large-scale data processing.
